pinyinchart.title: Pinyin Chart
pinyinchart.intro: Every Mandarin syllable is an initial (the consonant it starts with) plus a final (the vowel part). Find the initial's row and the final's column: the cell is the syllable. Tap a syllable to see its four tones — each tone is a different word, so we play a real character for each one.
pinyinchart.tableLabel: Pinyin syllables by initial and final
pinyinchart.pickHint: Tap a syllable to hear its tones.
